This notebook analyses data on habitat extent metrics and functional trends derived from Random Forest models.

# Load libraries

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(here)
library(purrr)
library(broom)
library(MASS)
library(ggplot2)
library(corrplot)
```

# Load data

```{r}
# Data of plots with constant habitat
RF_data_nochange <- read_csv(here("data", "RF", "MOTIVATE_ALL_V1_SPECTRAL"))
# Data of plots with habitat change
RF_data_change <- readRDS(here("data", "RF", "MOTIVATE_CHANGE_ALL_V1_SPECTRAL"))
```
